name: icalia
description: Icalia Labs house theme. Heavy Inter Black (900) display headlines, Trebuchet MS eyebrow caps, white page with deep navy (#1C2333) and Icalia red (#CC3239) as brand accents. Includes a fixed 4px left red accent bar that runs the full viewport height as a continuous brand signal. Best when sending from Icalia Labs and the buyer has no brand identity of their own to mirror, or when the seller explicitly wants the Icalia visual register (executive, restrained, factual).

wcag_note: Default brand color #CC3239 has 5.14:1 contrast on white (passes WCAG AA for normal text) and 3.05:1 on the #1C2333 navy inset (passes AA for large text only — keep the red as accent on dark surfaces, not body copy). White on navy is 15.7:1. If a different brand is supplied via --brand or extracted from the buyer's site, re-run the contrast check against the white page_bg as usual.
